title: Yeasty Molten German Flour Bread
description: A lazy Sunday dish featuring a strong white flour mixture, a mother-sauce-base, and a ooey-gooey molten center. This ovo-vegetarian-friendly German bread is perfect for a comforting brunch or snack.

ingredients.name: Mother Dough (from previous bread-making batch, or store-bought)

instructions: Combine Strong White Flour, Fresh Yeast, Salt, Sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Add melted Butter, Eggs, and Milk to the dry ingredients. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Gradually add Mother Dough and knead for 5 minutes.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Transfer dough to a greased 8x4 inch loaf pan.
Bake for an additional 20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 95°C.
Remove from oven, let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
